name: Santa's Cookies? What Cookies.
title: Christmas – French Bulldog Santa's Cookies? What Cookies. Mug
story: Santa's cookies? What cookies. A French Bulldog mug for the Frenchie owner whose dog cleaned the plate before Santa landed and now sits there looking innocent. It makes an easy Christmas morning coffee gift or stocking stuffer for anyone who has already lost a cookie to the dog.

The print is a fawn French Bulldog with big bat ears in a small red Santa hat, crumbs stuck to its muzzle and chest, sitting very upright beside an empty cracked plate, a tipped glass with a small puddle of milk, a candy cane, a blank note card and a few pine needles. SANTA'S COOKIES? runs above the dog in deep red capitals and WHAT COOKIES. stacks below it in big pine green letters, easy to read across the kitchen table, on bright white glossy ceramic.

It matches our Santa's Cookies? What Cookies. Frenchie tee, so the mug and the shirt make a set for the same plate-and-milk setup. Fill it with coffee or cocoa on Christmas Eve and let the crumbs do the talking.
joke_a: When the plate of Santa's cookies is empty and the French Bulldog sits next to it covered in crumbs, the only answer is what cookies. The Santa's Cookies? What Cookies. French Bulldog mug from Graphic Tees Co. puts that innocent face on a white mug, so every Frenchie owner gets the joke with each sip.
